item.title: Tesla ‘Robotaxi’ adds 5 more crashes in Austin in a month — 4x worse than humans
item.description: Tesla has reported five new crashes involving its “Robotaxi” fleet in Austin, Texas, bringing the total to 14 incidents since the service launched in June 2025. The newly filed NHTSA data also reveals that Tesla quietly upgraded one earlier crash to include a hospitalization injury, something the company never disclosed publicly. item.title: Tesla rolls first steering wheel-less Cybercab unit off the line before solving autonomy
item.description: Tesla shared today that the first Cybercab production unit has rolled off the assembly line at Gigafactory Texas. The vehicle has no steering wheel and no pedals. It is entirely dependent on autonomous driving software that, based on every available data point, Tesla has not solved — and is nowhere close to solving. Even the name “Cybercab” is not set in stone. more…
